title: Charles on the band's low pay in 1942
summary: Charles notes the salary was below par when he went into service as people worked the graveyard shift.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: I would like to say something.
Economy-wise, now, I know I left the band in September of '42. The salary wasn't too great. It
was really below par when I went in the service. After the people had started working the graveyard shift, AND THE WAR GOING. (unintelligible).
